disclosureQuote: Generative AI was used during development to assist in creating some pre-generated character animations and video transition sequences. No content is generated by AI during gameplay.
summary: 由有好莱坞影视经验的团队在洛杉矶实地拍摄的互动影剧，2026 年 10 月 14 日上市。开发者披露开发期用生成式 AI 辅助制作部分预生成的角色动画与视频过场序列，并声明游玩过程中没有任何内容由 AI 生成；其余六个领域都是披露未说明。
reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商与发行商同为 Interactive Films LLC；商店原始字段的名字首带一个空格，判定文件按采集到的开发者字段原样登记）与英文讨论区首页（可见 4 个主题，总数也是 4，即本作讨论区全部主题），首页没有与 AI 使用直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 0 篇原始来源：唯一一篇可能含本作 AI 相关信息的官方稿件是 Snail Games 附属 Interactive Films 发布在 GlobeNewswire 的本作新闻稿（中文），经 GitHub Actions 中转抓取返回 HTTP 403，正文不可读，无法核实稿件是否提及 AI 使用，按未读取登记，不据此推定任何领域；其余结果是本作商店页的中英文版本、社区中心页、SteamDB 图表页与收入估算页。检索范围仅限工具实际返回的内容，不能据此认定没有其他公开报道。领域判定全部来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计；本作商店页强调真人演员实拍，披露点名的 AI 产出限于预生成的动画与过场序列，运行时不生成的说法同样是开发者自述。
description: 由做过好莱坞影视的团队在洛杉矶地标实地拍摄的互动剧：五名真人演员、阵容由 20 万多次玩家投票决定，你扮演假扮阔少的留学生。

english.summary: A live-action interactive drama filmed in Los Angeles by a team with Hollywood experience, released on Oct 14, 2026. The developer states that generative AI was used during development to help create some pre-generated character animations and video transition sequences and that no content is generated by AI during gameplay; the other six areas are recorded as not addressed.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer and publisher Interactive Films LLC, whose store credit is recorded here exactly as collected, including its leading space) and the English discussion homepage, where all four topics of this game's board were visible; none directly concerns AI use and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 0 raw sources were read: the only item that could have carried information about AI use is the GlobeNewswire release in Chinese by Interactive Films, a subsidiary of Snail Games, announcing this game, and the relay fetch returned HTTP 403, so its body is unread, is recorded as not read and is not used to infer anything about any area. The remaining results were the store page in English and Chinese, the community hub, a SteamDB charts page and a revenue estimate page. That describes the search range and is not proof that no other coverage exists. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text itself and rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit: the store page stresses the filmed live-action cast, the named AI output is limited to pre-generated animations and transitions, and the claim that nothing is generated during play is also the developer's own.
